Senses.Explanation: Literally, an exposed or bare (露) pillar (柱): "the exposed pillar." It occurs 2,729 times in 325 allowlisted texts. In Chan halls it is not merely architecture: masters address it, strike it, point questioners to it, and pair it with the lantern. Danxia greets a pillar with joined palms as "World-Honored One"; when a monk says, "Master, that is an exposed pillar," Danxia answers with a verse about crying blood to no use. Shitou answers "what is the meaning of coming from the west?" with "ask the exposed pillar" (問取露柱); when the questioner cannot understand, Shitou says he understands even less. Asked to whom his teaching will be entrusted after his death, one master answers, "exposed pillar, fire stove" and reverses the pair after the follow-up. The pillar is also made an impossible animate figure: "like an exposed pillar bearing a child" (如露柱懷胎), a phrase found 87 times in 67 texts. Another verse says oxhide is stretched over the pillar, the pillar cries out, ordinary ears do not hear it, and the sages laugh. The Zen deviation is therefore concrete and institutional: a fixed hall support becomes a named interlocutor, recipient, speaker, and pregnant figure in encounters, commonly partnered with lantern or stove. These are the corpus's recorded actions; the entry adds no symbolic meaning.
Senses.Note: The common pair "lantern and exposed pillar" (燈籠露柱) occurs 288 times in 147 texts, while the reversed order "exposed pillar and lantern" (露柱燈籠) occurs 210 times in 121. Those pairings support the hall-fixture deployment but remain separate phrases.

Occurrences.Kwic: 牛皮鞔露柱。露柱啾啾叫。凡耳聽不聞。說聖呵呵笑
Occurrences.AttributionNote: 景德傳燈錄. Guizong Zhichang is the exact actor: his section records him saying 牛皮鞔露柱.

Occurrences.Kwic: 見露柱師合掌曰。不審世尊。一僧曰。和尚是露柱。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: 景德傳燈錄, Guangxiao Huijue section. Guangxiao Huijue is the exact actor who sees a pillar, joins his palms, and greets it as World-Honored One; a monk then tells him that he is the pillar. Zhaozhou Congshen is not the section subject.

Occurrences.Kwic: 問和尚百年後法付何人師云。露柱火爐。僧云。還受也無。師云。火爐露柱。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: 景德傳燈錄. Dasui Fazhen is the exact actor: he answers 露柱火爐 and reverses it.

Occurrences.Kwic: 長生問。混沌未分時含生何來。師曰。如露柱懷胎。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Five Lamps Meeting the Source (五燈會元), Lingyun Zhiqin section. Lingyun Zhiqin is the exact respondent: when Changsheng Jiaoran asks whence living beings come before chaos divides, Lingyun answers, 'like an exposed pillar bearing a child.'
